stem.text: Which graph represents the variation of pressure $p$ and volume $V$ of a sample of an ideal gas at constant temperature?

A.alt: p against V: a straight line sloping downwards from high p at low V to low p at high V, not passing through the origin.

B.alt: p against V: a straight line sloping upwards from near the origin, not reaching the origin.

C.alt: p against V: a curve that starts high at low V, stays nearly flat, then falls steeply towards the V axis at high V.

D.alt: p against V: a curve that falls steeply at low V and then flattens out, approaching but not touching the V axis (inverse relationship).
